children: Patriot National Bancorp entered into subordinated note purchase agreements with qualified institutional buyers to issue $10.0 million of 8.5% fixed-to-floating subordinated notes due 2036. The notes pay a fixed 8.5% semiannual coupon until Sep 30, 2031, then reset quarterly to three-month SOFR (minimum 0%) plus 416 bps. They are redeemable at the company’s option on or after Sep 30, 2031, subject to regulatory approval, and are intended to qualify as Tier 2 capital. The notes are unsecured, subordinated obligations of the company and are not guaranteed by subsidiaries.
